fee_assumption.source: Binance spot taker fee, set explicitly in the config
fee_assumption.slippage_note: no slippage model; market orders priced on the far side of the book

metrics.turnover_note: entry notional plus exit notional, approximated as 2x total stake
metrics.fees_note: derived as 2 x fee(0.001) x total stake; the engine reported no per-trade fee fields
metrics.passive_realised_exposure_matched_note: 50/50 passive return scaled to the strategy's realised average capital exposure; an approximation that ignores when that exposure occurred
metrics.provenance_note: Engine figures come from Freqtrade's own backtest export; exposure, turnover, fee and realised-exposure-matched figures are computed by research/summarize_backtest.py from the exported trade list. Both are recorded, and which is which is stated, because they are not equally strong evidence. Sharpe/Sortino/Calmar are reported on both of Freqtrade's bases rather than one being silently chosen.

analyses.lookahead_detail: 20 signals; 0 biased entries, 0 biased exits, 0 biased indicators
analyses.recursive_detail: no lookahead bias on indicators; drift at the strategy's 600 startup candles is 0.000% (ema_fast) and -0.003% (ema_slow)

reason: BASELINE_PROTOCOL_RESULT = PASS, BASELINE_PERFORMANCE_CLASSIFICATION = NEUTRAL. All seven pre-registered protocol criteria are met on real, checksum-verified Binance spot data: Dataset V2 structural integrity passes with exact 5m->1h price reconciliation; strategy and config hashes were frozen before the run; the backtest completed over the full four-year window with 5m detail simulation and no configuration error; lookahead analysis found no bias over 20 signals; recursive analysis found no indicator bias, with drift of 0.000% (ema_fast) and -0.003% (ema_slow) at the strategy's 600 startup candles; exposure, per-pair attribution, turnover and fee figures were computed rather than assumed; and no rule changed between the specification freeze and the evaluation. On performance, +27.80% against a realised-exposure-matched passive line of +29.18% gives E = -1.38 percentage points, well inside the NEUTRAL band pre-registered before any result existed. The strategy underperformed a passive position of the same average size, which is a legitimate result for a reference, not a protocol failure.
